name: Genesis
english_description: The official mudlib of Genesis, one of the oldest and most influential LPMuds still running. This is the engine only (master, login, std/ base classes, command souls, board/mail/bank/donation/report subsystems, the full wizard toolset) -- per the repo's own README, it ships no /d/Genesis game-world domain at all (no rooms, no NPCs, no items, no race content). Since no domain ships to place new characters in, this collection's copy adds a from-scratch character-creation bootstrap and a bare landing room so the engine is actually playable.
